## Dynamic Central Bank Simulator
<!-- TOP ROW -->
<div class="grid-top compact">

<div class="box fragment" data-fragment-index="1">
<strong>Core Definitions</strong><br>
• Inflation $(\pi_t)$ <br>
• Target $(\pi_t^*)$ <br>
• Output Gap $(Y_t - Y_t^*)$ <br>
• Natural Rate $(r^P)$
</div>

<div class="box math-small fragment" data-fragment-index="2">
<strong>Taylor Rule</strong>
$$
i_t = r^P + \pi_t + \theta_{\pi}(\pi_t - \pi_t^*) + \theta_y (Y_t - Y_t^*) + e_{(i,t)}
$$
• The Taylor Rule provides a systematic policy reaction function
</div>

<div class="box fragment" data-fragment-index="3">
<strong>Decision Algorithm</strong><br>
1. Diagnose $(\pi_t, gap)$ <br>
2. Compute $i_t$ <br>
3. Interpret <br>
4. Decide
</div>

</div>

<!-- SECOND ROW -->
<div class="grid-bottom compact">
<div class="box fragment" data-fragment-index="4">
<strong>Policy Logic</strong><br>
$(\pi_t \uparrow)$ & gap $\uparrow$ → Contract <br>

$(\pi_t \downarrow)$ & gap $\downarrow$ → Expand <br>

Supply shock → Caution

</div>
<div class="box fragment" data-fragment-index="5">
<strong>Transmission</strong><br>
<span style="color:#c0392b; font-weight:600;">
$i_t \uparrow \rightarrow$ Demand $\downarrow \rightarrow$ Gap $\downarrow \rightarrow$ Inflation $\downarrow$
</span>
<br><br>
<span style="color:#2980b9; font-weight:600;">
$i_t \downarrow \rightarrow$ Demand $\uparrow \rightarrow$ Gap $\uparrow \rightarrow$ Inflation $\uparrow$
</span>
<br><br>
</div>

</div>

<!-- ROW 2: TAKEAWAYS -->
<div class="box fragment" data-fragment-index="1" style="background:#f9f9f9;">
<strong>Key Takeaways</strong><br>

• <span class="contract">Contractionary policy</span> stabilizes inflation when $\pi_t > \pi_t^*$  
• <span class="expand">Expansionary policy</span> supports recovery when output is below potential  
• <span class="caution">Caution</span> is required under supply shocks  
• Policy operates with <strong>lags</strong> → avoid overreaction
